desc: Establish the contiguous-interval invariant: the owned slimes always form an interval containing the start, with size equal to its interval sum; a boundary slime may be crossed iff its value is strictly less than that sum.
Derive a concrete all-starting-positions algorithm via the maximum Cartesian tree, including strict comparisons and equality handling.
Implement the recursion-safe O(N) Cartesian-tree DP using 64-bit-compatible Python integers.
Validate against brute-force random small arrays and run all public samples.
